g.text: CI/CD pipeline: what runs, when, and from which file
Pull requests only check. A merge to main checks again, then publishes and deploys dev. Every job below is a real job in .github/workflows/apps-ci.yaml.
validate: helm lint + template + kubeconform + promtool alert rules
no build, no deploy: ArgoCD applies config changes itself
on a PR the pipeline stops here:
name: deploy dev (+ qa PR on release)
pull-requests: write # open the qa promotion PR
# 2) Gate: fail on CRITICAL vulnerabilities that have a fix available. HIGH is reported only.
report() { { echo "### ${{ inputs.app }} - image scan"; echo '```'; tail -n 30 trivy.txt; echo '```'; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; }
name: is this a new release?
image="${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}"; sha_tag="${{ steps.meta.outputs.sha_tag }}"; version="${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
if docker buildx imagetools inspect "$image:$version" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
